name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia VP vote 2 Dec
summary: Indonesia's assembly will pick a new vice-president on 2 Dec after Gibran's resignation; no G20 collapse or coup found
state: Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly will choose a new vice-president on 2 Dec from two candidates President Prabowo is to nominate after Vice-President Gibran resigned (The Star, 13 Nov). Coalition parties have left the choice to Prabowo and the process is expected to be uncontentious (Jakarta Post, 16 Nov). This is a constitutional succession, not a collapse, and searches on 20 Nov found no G20 coup, contested election or government collapse.
for_you: No direct effect for most readers. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for any country before going.
rubric_hit: Normal: no G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in past month; Indonesia VP succession is constitutional

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.

rubric.alert: Coup or constitutional crisis in a G20 country, or deadly unrest threatening a G20 government.
rubric.watch: Government collapse or contested election in a G20 country, or a coup anywhere.
rubric.normal: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month.
